findings.body: The relocation and reader update are present, but the required end-to-end proof is missing. This test's only Forge invocation is `--version`, which exits through argparse's version action (`src/forge/cli.py:118`) without exercising the guide. The remaining assertions inspect checkout files directly; the existing reader test likewise invokes only `--version` (`tests/test_fix_after_forge_migrate_old_forge_leftovers.py:11`). These provide static coverage, but do not satisfy the review contract's explicit functional-test requirement. Add meaningful acceptance coverage through the relevant real entry point rather than using the unrelated version check as that proof.
